protocol.measurementClock: deterministic clock advancing 1 ms per read (production condition, reproducible)
protocol.equivalenceClock: frozen at 2026-11-02T00:00:00.000Z; durable output must be byte-identical
protocol.order: each round alternates which side runs first
protocol.fixture: 40 seeded rows in state.json.observations-archive.jsonl; the large scenario adds sealed 1 KiB cycle segments plus their index; the warm-up drives the hot observation window past its limit so every measured write appends to the active archive, which the run asserts
protocol.instrumentedPass: a second pass per side with wrapped fs calls; two-path calls are attributed to the tree they write into, fsyncs through the fd's path

note: Two invocations of the same script, one per archive size, so each scenario has its own start/end load average. `scenarios[]` carries the measured rounds; `equivalence[]` is the frozen-clock byte comparison.
